verdict.rationale: Maritime's CLI is documented as built to be run by other agents. It offers `--json` output on every command, stable exit codes and a self-describing contract (maritime-docs-22, maritime-docs-9). Authentication is non-interactive through a never-expiring `MARITIME_TOKEN` env var (maritime-docs-23, maritime-docs-43), the CLI installs via npm, and a REST API with Bearer keys is available, so headless and CI use is clearly supported. Missing for 10: an explicit CI-pipeline integration guide or example (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
